privacy.camera_body: Camera access is used solely for attaching receipt photos and logbook documentation. Photos are stored securely and associated with your trip data only.
privacy.contact_body: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact us through the application.
privacy.data_collection_body: CrewLog collects only the data necessary to provide maritime logbook and expense tracking services. This includes account information (email, name), trip data, logbook entries (including GPS coordinates when permitted), crew information, and financial data for expense splitting.
privacy.gps_body: Location data is collected only when you actively use the logbook entry feature and grant permission. GPS coordinates are stored as part of your logbook entries to comply with maritime documentation standards. Location data is never shared with third parties or used for tracking purposes.
privacy.retention_body: Your data is retained for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.storage_body: All data is stored on secure, encrypted servers. Financial data related to expense splitting is used only for calculation purposes within your trip.
privacy.third_party_ecb: European Central Bank API for currency exchange rates
privacy.third_party_intro: CrewLog uses the following third-party services:
privacy.third_party_meteo: Open-Meteo API for weather data retrieval
privacy.third_party_payment: Payment processing for subscription management (via our website only)

settlement.currency_note: All amounts are calculated in euros. Expenses in other currencies are automatically converted at the daily rate. Rounding differences of a few cents may occur.
settlement.hint_desc: This is the optimized settlement proposal with minimal transfers. Each person only transfers once.
settlement.how_desc: The settlement proposal minimizes the number of necessary transfers and considers settlement groups (e.g. families or couples who want to settle together).
settlement.step1_example: Sven spent €1,137.13 and owes €290.35 share → Balance: +€846.78
settlement.step1_formula: Balance = (Deposits + Private Expenses) - Share of common expenses
settlement.step2_desc: Families or couples can be combined into settlement groups. Individual balances are summed and settled through the group representative.
settlement.step2_example: Sven (+€846.78) and Hanni (-€290.35) form the group "Niederheides"
settlement.step2_result: Group balance: +€556.43 (settled through Sven as representative)
settlement.step3_benefit: Minimal number of transactions - each person transfers at most once or receives at most once.
settlement.step3_desc: A greedy algorithm minimizes the number of transfers by always matching the largest credit with the largest debt.
settlement.title: Settlement Proposal

terms.accounts_body: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. Each account may manage trips with up to 12 crew members per trip.
terms.accuracy_body: While CrewLog assists with maritime logbook compliance, users are responsible for the accuracy of their logbook entries. GPS and weather data are provided as aids and should be verified.
terms.contact_body: For questions about these terms, please contact us through the application.
terms.financial_body: Expense splitting and settlement calculations are provided as convenience tools. Users should verify all financial calculations independently. Currency conversion rates are sourced from the European Central Bank and may not reflect real-time rates.
terms.liability_body: CrewLog is provided "as is" without warranties. We are not liable for any damages arising from the use of the service, including but not limited to inaccurate logbook data or financial calculations.
terms.modifications_body: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of modified terms.
terms.service_body: CrewLog is a multi-platform maritime logbook and crew expense management application. The service is available via web browser and native mobile applications.
terms.subscriptions_body: CrewLog offers free and premium subscription tiers. Subscriptions are managed exclusively through our website. Premium features require an active subscription.

help.new_trips_6: The yearly overview brings together the main trip and distance statistics.
help.new_logbook_1: Use the Day Logbook to record multiple entries for one day in a single form.
help.new_logbook_2: Entries are grouped by date and show weather, position, distance, and maneuvers clearly.
help.new_logbook_3: Quick fill can provide the time, GPS position, and current weather data.
help.new_logbook_4: Open existing entries to edit or delete them, or add an addendum without replacing the original.
help.new_logbook_5: Add photos directly to an entry with the camera or file picker, select multiple images, and save captions.
help.new_logbook_6: Export individual entries and complete days as PDFs; daily summaries include route and distance.
help.new_expenses_1: Upload receipts with the camera or as files and use OCR to suggest the key receipt fields.
help.new_expenses_2: Review and correct recognized values before saving; suggestions are never accepted without review.
help.new_expenses_3: Open, edit, or delete expenses and view or download their attached receipts.
help.new_expenses_4: Use templates for recurring expenses with preset category, amount, payment source, and split settings.
help.new_expenses_5: Wallet, private, participant, and percentage splits are included automatically in balances and settlement.
help.new_templates_groups_1: Admins can create, edit, and delete expense templates.
help.new_templates_groups_2: A template stores recurring details and makes new expense entry much faster.
help.new_templates_groups_3: Manage crew groups with a representative and multiple members for settlement.
help.new_templates_groups_4: Change representatives or members; the group assignment is used in the next settlement.
help.new_tracking_1: Open “🗺️ Track” from the Trips page to view the GPS route on a map.
help.new_tracking_2: The route uses the start, intermediate, and latest positions recorded in the logbook.
help.new_tracking_3: The daily breakdown shows route, entry count, and distance for each day.
help.new_tracking_4: GPS-calculated distances are labeled as automatic; manually entered daily distances remain available.
help.new_tracking_5: Jump from the daily breakdown directly to the matching day logbook or entry details.
help.new_access_1: Switch between Day Mode and Night Mode from the menu; the choice is saved for the device.
help.new_access_2: Night Mode uses a high-contrast black-and-red palette for onboard use in darkness.
help.new_access_3: Add CrewLog to the home screen as a PWA and use the offline page when the connection is interrupted.
help.new_access_4: Open About to enable or revoke the iOS widget and check its refresh status.
help.new_access_5: Switch between German and English at any time; the choice applies to the current session.
help.new_admin_1: Maintain the boat profile, home port, GPS coordinates, logo, and accent color in Boat Settings.
help.new_admin_2: Manage trip passwords and separate permissions for Admin, Trip Admin, and Crew.
help.new_admin_3: View plan limits and manage the subscription and billing portal from Billing.
help.new_admin_4: Use CSV and PDF exports for the wallet, balances, and logbook for archiving or sharing.
